name: Prokfinder
description: Selection, download and curation of prokaryote genomes (NCBI metadata, BacDive phenotypes, GTDB taxonomy)

options.name: --help
options.description: Show the help (of the sub-command, when given after it)

options.name: --check
options.description: Show which dependencies are installed and exit

options.name: --results-dir
options.description: Output directory (default: ./prokfinder-results)

options.name: --refdb-dir
options.description: Reference databases directory (default: \$HOME/prokfinder-refdb)

options.name: --threads
options.description: CPUs used by the programs (default: 4; with run-on-cluster, the CPUs of the job)

options.name: --memory
options.description: RAM the programs may use: 16gb, 16000mb or the number in GB (default: the RAM of the computer; with run-on-cluster, the RAM of the job)

options.name: --force-refdb
options.description: Download and install the databases again (the current ones are kept until the new ones are complete)

options.name: --ncbi-complete-metadata
options.description: Also write a table with every NCBI metadata field (slow; not used by the search)

options.name: --force-selection
options.description: Search again, even if the filters did not change

options.name: --force-search
options.description: Ignore the invalid values and filters (with a warning) and search with the valid ones; a filter left without valid values is removed

options.name: --assembly-source
options.description: NCBI table searched: genbank (default) or refseq

options.name: --gtdb-taxon
options.description: GTDB taxon name, any rank (e.g., g__Thermus, s__Thermus aquaticus or Thermus)

options.name: --gtdb-taxon-file
options.description: List of GTDB taxon names

options.name: --accession
options.description: Accession with version, GCA_ or GCF_ (e.g., GCA_000005845.2)

options.name: --accession-file
options.description: List of accessions

options.name: --isolation-source
options.description: Text or regular expression (extended regex, case-insensitive) found in the isolation source (e.g., "hot spring", "hot ?springs?", "^soil$")

options.name: --isolation-source-file
options.description: List of isolation sources (texts or regular expressions)

options.name: --country
options.description: Country of the geographic location (e.g., Brazil)

options.name: --country-file
options.description: List of countries

options.name: --genome-type
options.description: isolate_genome or mag

options.name: --gc
options.description: GC content in % (e.g., 40:65)

options.name: --temp-opt
options.description: Optimal growth temperature in °C (e.g., 45:80)

options.name: --ph-opt
options.description: Optimal pH (e.g., 5.5:8.5)

options.name: --salt-opt
options.description: Optimal NaCl concentration in % (e.g., 0:5)

options.name: --temp-growth
options.description: Growth temperature in °C (known for many more species than -T)

options.name: --ph-growth
options.description: Growth pH

options.name: --salt-growth
options.description: Growth NaCl concentration in %

options.name: --cell-shape
options.description: rod, coccus, ovoid, curved, spiral, filament, pleomorphic or other

options.name: --oxygen
options.description: aerobe, anaerobe, facultative or microaerophile

options.name: --gram-stain
options.description: positive or negative

options.name: --motility
options.description: Motile cells

options.name: --spore-formation
options.description: Forms spores

options.name: --energy-source
options.description: chemotroph or phototroph

options.name: --electron-donor
options.description: lithotroph or organotroph

options.name: --carbon-source
options.description: autotroph or heterotroph

options.name: --gzip
options.description: Keep the genome files compressed (.fna.gz)

options.name: --use-gtdbtk-tree
options.description: Place in the GTDB tree (GTDB-Tk) the genomes that the ANI did not classify (needs much more RAM; on the cluster, the high_mem queue). Can be given in a new run with the same output directory: only the genomes not classified yet are placed

options.name: --filter-mge
options.description: Mask the mobile genetic elements (PhiSpy) before comparing the genomes

options.name: --force-curation
options.description: Redo the curation from the downloaded genomes (by default, finished work is reused)

options.name: --skip-busco
options.description: Do not run BUSCO (by default it is reported, not used as a filter)

options.name: --download-threads
options.description: Concurrent genome downloads, 1-30 (default: 10)

options.name: --min-contig-length
options.description: Contigs shorter than this are removed (default: 1000)

options.name: --max-contigs
options.description: Maximum number of contigs (default: 1000)

options.name: --max-n-bases
options.description: Maximum number of ambiguous bases, N (default: 100000)

options.name: --min-n50
options.description: Minimum N50 (default: 5000)

options.name: --min-completeness
options.description: Minimum CheckM2 completeness (default: 75)

options.name: --max-contamination
options.description: Maximum CheckM2 contamination (default: 5)

options.name: --derep-method
options.description: skder (default; ANI) or cidder (clustering of the predicted proteins)

options.name: --derep-mode
options.description: skDER: greedy (default) or dynamic

options.name: --derep-ani
options.description: skDER: ANI above which two genomes are redundant (default: 99.5)

options.name: --test
options.description: Submit only a short job that shows the version of every program

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Only write the job script (do not submit it)

options.name: --queue
options.description: Submission queue (default: roteamento): qtime       tests and short runs (walltime of at most 72:00:00) roteamento  common runs (at most 24024 MB of RAM per job) high_mem    runs that need a lot of RAM (25 GB or more; e.g., --use-gtdbtk-tree)

options.name: --mem
options.description: RAM of the job: 20gb, 20000mb or only the number in GB (default: 20gb; at least 4gb, and 8gb with download-wf)

options.name: --cpus
options.description: CPUs of the job (default: 20; at least 4)

options.name: --walltime
options.description: Maximum run time of the job (default: 2160:00:00; 72:00:00 with qtime)

usage: assign-taxonomy-gtdb.sh - Prokfinder module 7: GTDB taxonomy of the genomes
build-taxonomic-dir-hierarchy.sh - Prokfinder module 8: taxonomic directory hierarchy

modules.description: dereplication of the genomes of each taxon (skDER or CiDDER)
usage: dereplicate-genomes.sh - Prokfinder module 9: dereplication of the genomes of each taxon (skDER or CiDDER)
download-reference-db-bacdive.sh - Prokfinder module 0.2: BacDive reference database
download-reference-db-gtdb.sh - Prokfinder module 0.3: GTDB reference database
download-reference-db-ncbi.sh - Prokfinder module 0.1: NCBI reference database
download-selected-genomes-from-db.sh - Prokfinder module 2: download of the selected genomes

modules.description: biological evaluation of the genomes (CheckM2 and BUSCO)
usage: evaluate-genome-completeness.sh - Prokfinder module 6: biological evaluation of the genomes (CheckM2 and BUSCO)
evaluate-genome-structure-seqkit.sh - Prokfinder module 4: structural evaluation of the genomes (seqkit)

modules.description: graphs of the final results of Prokfinder (called by summarize-final-results.sh)
gene prediction (Pyrodigal, the Python port of Prodigal)
usage: predict-genes-pyrodigal.py - Prokfinder: gene prediction (Pyrodigal, the Python port of Prodigal)
predict-genes-pyrodigal.sh - Prokfinder module 5: gene prediction of the genomes (Pyrodigal)

modules.description: genome search in the reference database
usage: search-genomes-in-reference-db.sh - Prokfinder module 1: genome search in the reference database

modules.description: execution on a cluster with the PBS queue manager

main-prokfinder.sh with the given arguments, then sends it to the queue with qsub. It is called by

submit-prokfinder-pbs.sh --test [--dry-run]                                         submit a short job that only
summarize-final-results.sh - Prokfinder module 10: final results and statistics

common_functions.name: die
common_functions.summary: Logs an error and stops the script

common_functions.name: make_temp_dir
common_functions.summary: Creates a temporary directory and stores its path in the variable named <var_name>. (It cannot be used as $(make_temp_dir): the registration would be lost in the subshell.)

common_functions.name: _pf_on_exit
common_functions.summary: Single EXIT handler: removes the temporary directories and the marker of the run, and lets tee finish writing the log

common_functions.name: pf_job_state
common_functions.summary: Prints the PBS state of a job (Q queued, R running, H held, E exiting...), or nothing when the job has finished, is unknown or PBS is not available

common_functions.name: pf_mark_results_dir_in_use
common_functions.summary: Writes the marker of the run in progress in <results_dir> (removed by the EXIT handler)

common_functions.name: start_logging
common_functions.summary: Copies everything printed by the script (stdout and stderr) to <log_file>, appending to it. The terminal keeps the colors; the color codes are removed from the copy written to the log file.

common_functions.name: setup_module_log
common_functions.summary: A module run on its own writes its own log. When it is called by main-prokfinder.sh (PROKFINDER_LOG is set), its output already goes to the main log, so nothing is done.

common_functions.name: count_records
common_functions.summary: Prints the number of data rows of a TSV file (header excluded)

common_functions.name: count_lines
common_functions.summary: Prints the number of lines of a file (0 if it does not exist)

common_functions.name: file_mtime
common_functions.summary: Prints the modification time of a file in seconds (0 if it does not exist)

common_functions.name: get_column_index
common_functions.summary: Prints the 1-based position of the first column whose header matches one of the given names. The comparison ignores case and every character that is not a letter or a digit, so "ASSEMBLY_ACCESSION", "Assembly Accession" and "assemblyaccession" are the same name. Prints nothing if there is no match.

common_functions.name: require_column
common_functions.summary: Same as get_column_index, but stops the script with a clear message if the column does not exist

common_functions.name: pf_write_null_mapping
common_functions.summary: Writes the mapping of the values converted to NULL (rows appended by pf_null_write) with its header, the same value of the same column summed over the parts, sorted by table, column and occurrences

common_functions.name: format_tsv
common_functions.summary: Formats a TSV read from stdin and writes it to stdout: - header: spaces are replaced by "_" (with <upper> = 1 the header is also converted to upper case and every run of characters other than letters/digits becomes "_", e.g. "Assembly BioSample Isolation source" -> ASSEMBLY_BIOSAMPLE_ISOLATION_SOURCE) - cells: trimmed; empty or invalid values (see PF_AWK_NULL) -> NULL; with <null_rows> the converted values are appended to it (pf_null_write), under the name <table> - every row gets the same number of columns as the header (missing cells -> NULL)

common_functions.name: add_metadata_columns
common_functions.summary: Adds the columns of <table> to <master>. In both files the first column is the assembly accession. Columns of <master> with the same name as a column of <table> are replaced, so a stage can be re-run and its columns are simply refreshed. Accessions missing from <table> get NULL in the new columns.

common_functions.name: select_accessions
common_functions.summary: Prints the accessions (first column) of the rows of <tsv> whose column <column_name> has one of the given values

common_functions.name: genome_file_of
common_functions.summary: Prints the path of the genome file of <accession> in <dir> (<accession>.fna or <accession>.fna.gz), or nothing if there is none

common_functions.name: absolute_path
common_functions.summary: Prints a path as an absolute path (the file or folder must exist)

common_functions.name: pending_for_cache
common_functions.summary: Prints the rows of <genomes.tsv> (<accession> <TAB> <file> <TAB> <mtime> ...) whose (accession, mtime) is not in <cache>

common_functions.name: update_cache
common_functions.summary: Adds <new_rows> to <cache>, replacing the old rows of the same accessions

common_functions.name: pf_python_with_pyrodigal
common_functions.summary: Prints a Python interpreter that has the "pyrodigal" package (nothing if there is none): python3/python of the PATH, or the Python of the environment of skDER/CiDDER, which use Pyrodigal (on the UFV cluster, module skder)

common_functions.name: run_in_own_env
common_functions.summary: Runs a program with the folder of its own executable first in the PATH. A program installed in its own conda environment that starts with "#!/usr/bin/env python3" (e.g., BUSCO) would otherwise run with the python3 of another environment that comes first in the PATH (on the UFV cluster, the module skder, loaded last) and fail with "No module named ...". The helpers of the program (e.g., hmmsearch for BUSCO) are also taken from its environment.

common_functions.name: pf_memory_gb
common_functions.summary: Prints an amount of RAM in GB, rounded down: "20gb", "20g" or "20" -> 20; "24000mb" -> 23. Returns 1 (prints nothing) if the format is invalid.

common_functions.name: pf_system_memory_gb
common_functions.summary: Prints the total RAM of the computer in GB (rounded down), or nothing when it cannot be found

common_functions.name: require_programs
common_functions.summary: Stops the script if one of the given programs is not in the PATH

common_functions.name: pf_ncbi_genomes_dir
common_functions.summary: NCBI (<ncbi_dir> = .../REFERENCE-METADATA/NCBI; <source> = genbank | refseq)

common_functions.name: pf_bacdive_brute_dir
common_functions.summary: BacDive (<bacdive_dir> = .../REFERENCE-METADATA/BACDIVE)

common_functions.name: pf_gtdb_prefix
common_functions.summary: GTDB (<gtdb_dir> = .../REFERENCE-METADATA/GTDB)

common_functions.name: pf_completed_marker
common_functions.summary: Checkpoint written by each download module when it finishes successfully

common_functions.name: pf_refdb_format_ok
common_functions.summary: Returns 0 if the checkpoint of <db_dir> exists and records the table format <version>

search.install: conda install -c conda-forge ncbi-datasets-cli (installed together with datasets)
conda install -c bioconda taxonkit (used by setup)

download-wf.install: conda install -c bioconda busco (not needed with download-wf --skip-busco)
conda install -c bioconda skder (also installs cidder)
pip install pyrodigal (or conda install -c bioconda pyrodigal; it comes with skder)

optional.install: conda install -c bioconda gtdbtk (ANI of the genomes that are not in the GTDB tables; GTDB tree with download-wf --use-gtdbtk-tree)
conda install -c conda-forge r-base (graphs of the final results)

environment_variables.CHECKM2DB: path of the CheckM2 database file (download-wf)
environment_variables.GTDBTK_DATA_PATH: folder of the GTDB-Tk reference package (ANI and tree classification)
environment_variables.NCBI_API_KEY: optional NCBI API key (more requests per second)
